rationale: This record is a book review (by Matthew Butler of Elsie Rockwell's 2008 monograph) concerning post-revolutionary education and state formation in Tlaxcala, Mexico. It does not address household or community water or sanitation service access (Criterion 1), water/sanitation governance mechanisms (Criterion 2), primary empirical research or systematic synthesis (Criterion 3), or water/sanitation access outcomes (Criterion 4). Primary exclusion reason: E01 (wrong topic).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both narrow and plain readings of Criterion 2 because the record is a book review on the history of post-revolutionary education and state formation in Tlaxcala, Mexico, with no connection to water or sanitation service access.
